canonical_project: Ooredoo Tunisie La Charguia 1 Data Center
notes: Ooredoo Tunisia data center at La Charguia 1, Tunis (WMC press visit 2016-02-19 confirms physical site; technical director Hatem Mestiri). Ooredoo hosting pages are A-grade for service claim that customer data is stored in Ooredoo Tunisia data centers. Capacity/specs not published.
